lines.say: This man bought twelve thousand cups of pudding. On purpose.
David Phillips, 1999. You mail in ten barcodes early, and get a thousand airline miles.
And the cups cost twenty five fucking cents.
So he spent about three grand, and told the stores he was stocking up for Y2K.
Problem is, peeling twelve thousand barcodes takes forever. So he called the Salvation Army.
They peeled the labels, they got the pudding, and he got an eight hundred dollar tax write off.
He walked away with over one point two million airline miles.
Plus American Airlines Gold status. For life. The crazy bastard.
A good reason to come back will make people do wild shit.
All your regulars need is a nudge. No pudding required.
Message Health tracks every regular, and sends the nudge for you.
